summary: Regression suite re-run after code-quality refactor of import_csv() into 5 helper functions (_validate_upload, _read_csv_smart, _row_get, _build_order_doc, _summarize_buckets). All 25/25 backend tests pass identically against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. CSV import returns the same expected counts (total_rows=1731, late=57, on_time=1534, pending=134, excluded=6). UTF-8 BOM + semicolon delimiter handled correctly. _build_order_doc produces the same fields (situacao, forma_envio, previsao_entrega, data_entrega, days_late, status_bucket, etc.). Dashboard, orders (filters/search/pagination), late highlights, late report CSV, tickets CRUD and edge cases (empty body 400, bad extension 400, headers-only 400) all behave identically. Refactor is functionally equivalent — no regressions.

minor.issue: Sort key still only days_late (many ties at 0). Pages can overlap. Add stable secondary sort (e.g., id) for deterministic pagination. Pre-existing, not introduced by refactor.
Still not atomic: db.orders.delete_many({}) precedes insert_many. If insert fails midway, prior data is lost. Pre-existing, not introduced by refactor.
No auth/rate limiting on a destructive endpoint that wipes orders + tickets collections. Pre-existing.

action_items: (Optional, carry-over) Add stable secondary sort key for /api/orders.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: import_csv() is now ~30 lines and delegates to single-purpose helpers. Public response model and external behavior unchanged.
_validate_upload, _read_csv_smart, _row_get, _build_order_doc, _summarize_buckets are individually testable and side-effect-free (except DB writes which remain in import_csv).
_read_csv_smart correctly tries (utf-8-sig, utf-8, latin-1, cp1252) x (';',',') and normalises headers; matches prior behavior.
_build_order_doc preserves all original fields including is_late, days_late, status_bucket, imported_at; verified by test_orders_default and test_late_detection_logic.
_summarize_buckets initialises all 4 buckets to 0 — safer than the previous inline accumulation.
server.py is still ~540 lines; splitting into routers/{import,orders,tickets,dashboard} + helpers/* remains a worthwhile next step but is not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Reused /tmp/relatorio_sla.csv (already present from iteration_1, 595816 bytes). Session fixture imports it; final test wipes data — re-import via UI/API for manual verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor regression: 25/25 pytest still green on the public URL. CSV at /tmp/relatorio_sla.csv. Expected counts: total=1731, late=57, on_time=1534, pending=134, excluded=6.
